name: Dock
description: macOS-style magnifying dock of icon buttons that grow near the pointer with spring physics, with labels, badges, active dots, hop on click, long-press or right-click menus with submenus, and optional auto-hide.
contents: Floating glass toolbar panel with one tile button per item, optional separators
Hover labels, notification badges (count or dot), active indicator dots
Context menu per item with icons, shortcuts, checks, separators and nested submenus
behavior: Items magnify by a cosine falloff based on pointer distance, animated with a spring simulation in requestAnimationFrame
Clicking an item makes it hop with a gravity bounce, then calls its onClick
Long press (450ms), right-click, context menu key or arrow toward the screen opens a popover menu with a tail pointing at the item
Menu supports keyboard navigation, hover highlight, delayed submenu opening and closes on outside click, scroll, resize or blur
Arrow keys, Home and End move focus between items, focused item magnifies
Auto-hide slides the dock off its edge and reveals it when the pointer nears that edge or the dock gets focus
Dock scales down (to a minimum of 40 percent) to fit the available width or height of its container
Reduced motion setting disables springs, hop and scale animation
editableByProps: Items: icons, labels, click handlers, badges, active state, separators, context menus and submenus
Screen edge via position (bottom, top, left, right)
Item size, magnification, reach distance, panel thickness, gap, corner roundness
Spring mass, stiffness and damping, hop bounce on or off
Auto-hide, bare icons instead of tiles, labels, indicators and badges on or off
Badge and accent colors, extra class name and inline style or CSS variable overrides

needsCodeEdit.change: Change long-press duration or hop height
Change distance of the dock from the screen edge
needsCodeEdit.where: EDGE constant and the ROOT_SIDES classes

needsCodeEdit.change: Change menu size, corner radius or tail shape
needsCodeEdit.where: MENU_LIST, MENU_RADIUS, TAIL and TAIL_HALF constants and the menuPath function

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the glass blur of the panel
needsCodeEdit.where: backdrop-blur classes in the ROOT constant

fixed: Positioned absolutely, so the parent container must be position relative with a defined size, the dock sits at the container edge with a 12px offset
Menus render in a portal on document.body with fixed positioning at z-index 1000
Adds window pointermove and pointerdown listeners for auto-hide, and scroll, resize and blur listeners while a menu is open
Dock shrinks to fit its container, never below 40 percent of the set sizes, so very narrow screens get tiny tiles
Magnification is pointer based, on touch screens only long-press menus and focus magnify
Toolbar aria-label is hardcoded to Dock and uses a client component directive
Theme colors are hardcoded dark or light tokens, unknown theme falls back to dark, unknown position falls back to bottom
Icons must be supplied by the caller as React nodes, no icons are built in

options.look: Dark translucent glass panel with dark gradient tiles, light icons and dark menus
options.useWhen: Dark or media-heavy page where the dock floats over a dark hero or app background

options.look: Light frosted glass panel with white tiles, dark icons and light menus
options.useWhen: Light, bright page or product site where the dock floats over white or pastel content
